Description: Verify that VMs are deployed across availability zones.
Risk: VMs not in availability zones are susceptible to datacenter failures.

Code.Other: 1. Deploy multiple VM instances or a VM Scale Set across Availability Zones, or configure Azure Site Recovery for zone-to-zone disaster recovery.

Recommendation.Text: Deploy multiple VM instances or a VM Scale Set across Availability Zones, or configure Azure Site Recovery for zone-to-zone disaster recovery.
